title: X UI research for Download More RAM
method: 28 x.com searches in the signed-in built-in browser (Top tab, min_faves/since/filter:videos/from), top replies of 22 posts read, every row confirmed via api.fxtwitter.com on 2026-10-21, media of 35 posts frame-sheeted with ffmpeg, HN Algolia Show HN >100 points, Product Hunt for gaps; reddit blocked for the crawler.
engagement_bar: 500+ likes or 50k+ views for general UI clips; 100+ likes or a reply thread of specific praise for niche Mac/dev tools

hn.title: Show HN: WhatCable, a tiny menu bar app for inspecting USB-C cables
ui_comments: why do a lot of Mac apps insist on living in the menu bar?
should just be a regular app with an optional menu bar option
to the right of the notch is already close to full
custom-drawn rows often read as one blob (VoiceOver)
I love that this is a native mac app

recommendation.direction: A. Thermostat for memory: dark translucent instrument popover (AC-popover grammar) with a DIMM cell grid as the object, hero free-memory numeral, pressure bar, one Download button, lever tiles, app/session rows
recommendation.signature: The panel changes temperature: ember near the wall, slate when memory is back; pressing Download fills dot-matrix cells while the numeral counts measured MB and the tint cools; the menu-bar glyph cools with it
risks: template already cloned 3x in 4 days; identity must come from the DIMM + tint
dark-first needs a real light mode and Reduce Transparency fallback
any glass that lags gets punished (#30, #31)
